-In accordance with the approval made by the plenary session of the Securities and Exchange

HEREBY DECIDES
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
ARTICLE 1.-Purposes
This Prakas aims to ensure the conducts of the Custodian Agent through the establishment
of the operating mechanisms, investors’ interest protection, and organization’s conducts to ensure
the effectiveness of the Custodian Agent’s services.
ARTICLE 2.- Objectives
The objectives of this Prakas are to prescribe the requirements, mechanisms and procedures
for accrediting the Custodian Agent in the securities sector, and to determine its obligations
pursuant to the Law on the Issuance and Trading of Non-Government Securities ,the Anukret on
the Implementation of the Law on Issuance and Trading of Non-Government Securities and other
related regulations.
ARTICLE 3.-Scope
This Prakas shall be applied to the SECC-accredited Custodian Agent to operatethe
custodian services in the Kingdom of Cambodia.
ARTICLE 4.- Definition
The technical terms used in this Prakas shall be determined within this article and are available
in the glossary of the annexes of the Law on the Issuance and Trading of Non-Government
Securities and Anukret on the Implementation of the Law on the Issuance and Trading of Non-
Government Securities.
- Custody Account refers to the client’s account which is opened and safe kept at the
Custodian Agent.
- Applicant refers to the person applying for the accreditation to be the custodian agent inthe
securities sector.

CHAPTER II
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ACCREDITATION
ARTICLE 5.-Eligibility
The eligible person:
-Any commercial bank licensed by the National Bank of Cambodia in accordance with the
Law on Banking and Financial Institutions and related regulations of the bank sector and shall in
advance be granted the “Non-refusal” letter by the National Bank of Cambodia.
- The operator of the securities depository of the Cambodia Securities Exchange (CSX) .
ARTICLE 6.-Requirements
The applicant shall:
1. Have minimum capital of 4,000,000,000 (four billion) riels and reserve the guarantee
capital of 15% out of the minimum capital in the SECC bank account at the National Bank
of Cambodia. This condition shall not apply to the applicants that are the Commercial
Banks. However, the latter applicants shall reserve the guarantee capital of 600.000.000
(Six hundred million) riels in the SECC bank account at the National Bank of Cambodia;
2. Have the effective operating capacity;
3. Have the separated section equipped with the appropriate Chinese Wall to operate the
services in the securities sector;
4. Have the sufficient human resource with the following requirements:
- A director in charge of the Agent shall comply with the requirements prescribed in the
Article 7 of this Prakas;
- A head of operation shall comply with the requirements prescribed in the Article 8 of this
Prakas;
- A head of Compliance shall comply with the requirements prescribed in the Article 9 of
this Prakas;
- A head of Finance shall comply with the requirements prescribed in the Article 10 of this
Prakas;
5. Have the IT systems including the back-up, recovery, and connectivity systems to operate n

9. Have Know-Your-Client (KYC) principles; and
10. Have a one-year business plan, a risk management plan, a contingency plan, and the internal
control mechanisms.
ARTICLE 7.-Qualifications for Director
The director in charge shall:
1. Have at least bachelor degree in management, economics or finance; and
2. Have experience related to the securities or finance sector.
3. Have good character and morality prescribed in the Article 42 of the Anukret;
4. Have never been declared bankrupt or have never caused one or more companies to go
bankrupt during the last 5 (five) years upon to the applying date;
5. Have never committed any disgraceful act in the securities market or financial sector;
6. Have never acted against the public interests;
ARTICLE 8.-Qualifications for the Head of Operation
The Head of Operation shall:
1. Have at least bachelor degree in management, economics, or finance; and
2. Have experience related to the securities or financial sector.
ARTICLE 9.-Qualifications for the Head of Compliance
The Head of Compliance shall:
1. Have at least bachelor degree in Law; and
2. Have experience related to the securities or financial sector.
ARTICLE 10.-Qualifications for Head of Finance
The Head of Finance shall:
1. Have at least bachelor degree in Finance or Accounting; and
2. Have experience related to the securities or financial sector.

ARTICLE 12.-Attachments
The applicant shall attach the application form with the following attachments:
1. A certified true copy of the commercial bank license;
2. A certified true copy of company registration certificate;
3. A certified true copy of patent certificate;
4. A certified true copy of tax registration certificate;
5. A certified true copy of the articles of incorporation;
6. A recommendation of the minimum capital ( not applied to the commercial banks);
7. A Recommendation of the reserved guarantee capital;
8. An organizational structure of commercial bank or The operator of the securities depository
of CSX and agency section ;
9. A Curriculum Vitae, Degree(s), Experience Recommendation(s),Criminal Court(s) issued
by the authority, certified Khmer Identification Card or Passport of the director in charge,
head of operation, head of compliance and head of finance;
10. Audited or consolidated financial statements by the independent auditor for the last two
years;
11. A client agreement Specimen;
12. The services principles in the securities sector in accordance with the Article 21 of this
Prakas and the services mechanisms;
13. The operating policies, procedures, and mechanisms;
14. The documents related to the information system prescribed in the Article 6 of this Prakas;
and
15. A business plan, a risk management plan, and a contingency plan.
ARTICLE 13.- Additional Documents and Clarification
The Director General of the SECC may require the applicant to provide further documents
and clarification or the other necessary information to ensure the applicant has fulfilled all the
requirements prescribed in this Prakas.

The Director General of the SECC may reject the application on following grounds: n

1. The applicant fails to comply with any requirement prescribed in this Prakas, or any
guideline in accordance with this Prakas, or other relevant regulations;
2. Any information or document submitted to the SECC contains the in corrector misleading
information;
3. The applicant is in the course of being terminated or dissolved;
4. The applicant fails to settle in whole or in part the debt in accordance with the court
judgments.
5. The applicant, director in charge, head of operation, head of compliance, or head of finance
of the applicant:
a. has conducted the business with fraud, deceit, or any misconduct;
b. has contravened any law and regulation protecting the public against financial loss due to
the dishonesty, incompetence or malpractice by the person in the financial services or the
company management;
c. has committed or has been associated with any other business practice casting doubt on
his competence and soundness of decision, or to cause the conflict of interest;
d. is unable to act in the clients’ best interest because of their reputation, character, financial
integrity and reliability;
e. is unable to efficiently, loyally and fairly conduct their business in accordance with the
accreditation requirements.
6. The applicant or any applicant’s shareholder holding substantial voting shares used to
declare bankrupt either inside or outside Cambodia for the last five years upon the applying
date;
7. The other circumstances which are likely to:
a. lead to the business misconducts by the applicant, director in charge, head of operation,
head of compliance, head of finance, or any share holder holding the substantial voting
shares of the applicant;
b. reflect the untrustworthiness on the applicant’s business models.
8. The applicant has or may have involved with the money laundering and terrorism financing
or the applicant accreditation may impact the public interests. n

CHAPTER IV
ACCREDITATION FEE
ARTICLE 17.-Application and Document Processing Fee
The applicant shall pay for the application and processing fee of 2,000,000 (two million)
riels on the applying date.
ARTICLE 18.-Non-returnable
The application form with the attachments, and the application and processing fee shall not
be returned although rejected.
ARTICLE 19.- Annual Accreditation Fee
The Agent shall pay for the annual accreditation fee of 20,000,000 (twenty million) riels
before every January 15. For the first year of the accreditation, the fee shall be:
- 20,000,000 (twenty million) riels if accredited in quarter 1,
- 15,000,000 (fifteen million) riels if accredited in quarter2.
- 10,000,000 (ten million) riels if accredited in quarter 3.
- 5,000,000 (five million) riels if accredited in quarter 4.
ARTICLE 20 .- Other Fee
The Agent shall pay for the application and processing fee of 100,000 (one-hundred
thousand) riels upon applying for the Replacement of the Director in charge, head of operation,
head of compliance, or head of finance, and the business relocation, or aments in services
principles, clients’ agreement specimen.

ARTICLE 22.-Client agreement
The client agreement shall be in writing with the signatures of the clients, and the Agent
shall explain in details to the clients before signing. The agreement shall include the following
minimum contents:
1. The full name and address of the Agent;
2. The client identity with the Investor ID issued by the SECC, a certified copy of the
documents, such as the identification card, passport, certificate of incorporation or other
official documents which uniquely identify the client identity;
3. The description of the services and/or other services availability;
4. The fee description and other expenses burdened by the clients;
5. The detailed rights entitled to the Agent to arrange the corporate actions related-tasks;
6. The detailed report received by the clients and methods of receiving, and services
notification;
7. The rights and obligations of the parties;
8. The requirements and procedures for offering, suspending, and terminating the services;
9. The client confidentiality and its uses;
10. The detailed procedures for the conflict resolution including the client complaints;
11. The detailed professional insurance;
12. The beneficiary in case the death of any client; and n

CHAPTER VI
OBLIGATIONS OF THE CUSTODIAN AGENT
ARTICLE 23.-General Obligations
The Agent shall:
1. Ensure the professional, secure and effective services;
2. Strictly adhere to the requirements prescribed in the Article 6 of this Prakas;
3. Strictly adhere to the principles of the services, and client agreement;
4. Open, monitor and safe keep the clients’ custody accounts;
5. Safe keep the cash, securities, and other assets on behalf of the clients;
6. Monitor and follow-up the executed securities transactions of the clients,
7. Settle the cash, securities, and other assets on behalf of the clients;
8. Facilitate the currency exchange ordered by the clients;
9. Calculate and report the tax obligation to the clients, and pay taxes on behalf of the clients;
10. Arrange and monitor the cash, securities and other assets transactions for the securities
investment purposes;
11. Precisely monitor and manage the risks that may arise;
12. Verify and report all the cash, securities, and other assets transactions obtained from the
related persons to its clients to ensure the correct and up-to-date records.
13. Collect and settle the cash, securities, and other assets in accordance with the clients
agreement, and immediately notify them;
14. Calculate the Net Asset Value (NAV), and record the clients’ assets based on its mark-to-
market valuation and notify them;
15. Monitor the principles and methods in NAV valuation of the related persons, and examine
NAV valuation to ensure the correctness; and
16. Monitor all the expenses and securities investment activities,and report the Director
General of the SECC in case of any misconduct, money laundering, terrorism financing, or
any other breach related to the investment. n

ARTICLE 25.-The Custody Account Safekeeping
The Agent shall open the accounts for each client under their names, and shall not consider
such assets as the Agent’s, and shall ensure that each client asset shall not be mixed with those of
others or with the Agent’s.
The Agent shall not be entitled to arrange the cash, securities and other assets which are not
stipulated in the client agreement.
Entrusted Assets in the accounts shall not be used to settle the Agent’s debt or any other
person’s debt including the financial issues, the control of the transitional Director, the liquidation,
or the other similar circumstances.
ARTICLE 26.- Confidentiality
The Agent shall keep confidential, and ensure that the director in charge, head of operation,
head of compliance, and head of finance as well as the other relevant staffs in charge of services
keep confidential and shall not disclose the information to the third parties unless required by the
Law, the court judgment, SECC, or client’s written agreement.
ARTICLE 27.-Monitoring and Evaluation Mechanisms
The Agent shall strictly implement the internal control and evaluate the operation to ensure
the effectiveness of the services.
The internal control procedures shall be preventative and detective. The preventative
measures aim to prevent or maximally reduce the frauds or errors. The detective measures aim to
detect frauds or errors to promptly take corrective actions.
The internal control shall be documented and modified, or promptly reviewed once any
amendment of law or regulation.
ARTICLE 28.-Records and Documents Safekeeping

least ten years:

ARTICLE 29.-Timely Report
The Agent shall immediately report the Director General of the SECC in writing any of the
following events:
1. Amendment to the operation procedures;
2. Change in the director in charge, head of operation, head of compliance, or head of finance;
3. Change of the business location;
4. Services termination, or renew;
5. Non-compliance with the operating procedures, or clients’ agreement,and othermeasures;
6. Issues leading to the services default;
7. Measures taken to overcome the adverse circumstances or other risks affecting the services;
and
8. Other information determined by the Director General of the SECC.
ARTICLE 30.-Monthly Report
The Agent shall submit monthly report to the SECC in at most seven working days after the

operating results including:
1. Account opening and closing;
2. Each account transaction;
3. Each account balance;
4. List and identity of clients;
5. Types of assets in the safekeeping account;
6. Any service-related challenge; and

ARTICLE 32.-Annual Report
Within 3 (three) months after the end of each fiscal year or after other period permitted by
the Director General of the SECC, the Agent shall submit the report of the previous fiscal year
including the audited financial statement to the SECC, and the report shall containthe following
minimum contents:
1. the Agent’s general information;
2. Message of the director in charge
3. Operating Results
4. Financial Information
5. Management discussion
6. Corporate Governance information
7. Corporate Actions Information
8. Business Plan Information
9. Any measure to overcome adverse circumstances or other risks affecting the services; and
10. The other information determined by the Director General of the SECC.
The Agent shall submit timely report, monthly report,quarterly report and annual report to
the SECC using the forms determined by the Director General of the SECC.

ARTICLE 34.-The change in business location, and the amendment in Services Principle, or
client’s agreement specimen
Any change in business location, and any amendment in Services Principle, or client’s
agreement specimen shall in advance be approved by the Director General of the SECC by logging
the application form and the attachments, and pay for the application and processing fee prescribed
in the article 20 of this Prakas.
Article 35.-Business Suspension and Termination
The Agent shall request and in advance be approved by the Director General of the SECC for:
- The services suspension.
- The services termination. For the services termination, at the Agent shall in advance submit
the proposal with the clear reasons and attach the termination procedures, and it shall
terminate the services and completely settle with the remaining clients in at most 6 (six)
months or any period permitted by the Director General of the SECC.
ARTICLE 36.-Inspection by the SECC
The business operation and the effectiveness of the business performance may be inspected
by the SECC officials.
The Agent shall fully cooperate with the SECC officials to ensure the inspection
effectiveness.

ARTICLE 38.-Transitional Fine Measures
Regardless of the other penalties stipulated in the law and regulations in the securities sector
and applicable laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Cambodia, the Agent and any related person
breaches the Article 20, point 4,7,9,10,11,12,13,14,15 of the Article 23, Article 25 ,Paragraph 2 of
the Article 36, and the Article 37 of this Prakas or fails to comply with the direction from the
Director General of the SECC, shall be sanctioned prescribed in the paragraph 2 of the article 37 of
this Prakas and /or shall be transitionally fined in cash by the SECC as follow:
1. 100.000.000 (one hundred million) riels for the individual.
2. 200.000.000 (two hundred million) riels for the legal entity .
If the Agent breaches the Article 19 of this Prakas, the Agent shall be transitionally fined of
1,000,000 (one million) riels for one-day late by the SECC.
CHAPTER VIII
FINAL PROVISIONS
ARTICLE 39.- Other Guidelines
The SECC may issue the guidelines to facilitate the awareness and enforce the compliance
with this Prakas to the related persons, securities market participants and public.
ARTICLE 40.- Contravention
All provisions contrary to this Prakas are here by abrogated.
ARTICLE 41.- Implementation
The Director General of the SECC, the Department of Securities Market Supervision, the
Department of Legal Affairs, other Departments and Unit of the Securities and Exchange
Commission of Cambodia, and all relevant persons shall effectively implement this Prakas after the
signing date.
